For visitors

The shop's page says ride times are subject to change and to sign up for the shop's newsletter for current times; it also says many rides are weather permitting. Bring a bike in good working order, water and a helmet.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Leisure.
Check
Look at @spokesbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spokes Sunday Gravel Ride group ride

Spokes Sunday Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Wheaton, IL. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Spokes Bikes, Wheaton store.

The shop's Sunday gravel ride from the Wheaton store: about three hours, listed as a leisure ride. All experience levels are welcome, in the shop's words.
